message.value: An LLM on its own is raw general intelligence — powerful, but generic, and it forgets. Everything that makes an agent yours lives in the layer around the model — the harness: memory, tools, permissions, verification. The model can change; your way of working stays yours. That is Augmented intelligence, and it is owned by you.

story_structure.value: Ten lines over one progressive diagram build (20 segments, 15 distinct images): title card (music only, 0–2.2 s) — L1 the misconception opening ('Your AI model is not your agent') — L2 the problem stack (forgets everything; can't open your files; can't check its own work) — L3 the turn ('What turns it into an agent is the layer around it. The harness. It has four parts.') — L4–L7 the enumeration: Memory, Tools, Permissions, Verification, one compartment per line, each lighting on the panel in spoken order and persisting — L8 the miss ('Models come and go… every bit of customization lives in the harness') — L9 the wearing ('You wear it, like a second cortex. Your memory. Your rules. Your files.') — L10 the naming and ownership finale ('That's Augmented intelligence… Owned by you.'), closing on the end hold (finale frame, music fades).
